Seety station pricing + BNetzA/Mobilithek EVSE identity

policy: Exact station/EVSE evidence only. Seety currently exposes 0.62 EUR/kWh for the Reload-Solution station at Am Ufer 2, Kamen, while the BNetzA/Mobilithek-backed station record identifies the corresponding DE*RLS EVSEs. No DE*RLS-wide fallback is inferred and no fee beyond the explicitly displayed 0.00 EUR session unlock / 0.00 EUR per-minute post-charge parking is modeled.
